messages:
jordan: quick idea — can we try a micro-followup format for PMs on postmortems? short, 3-item checklist and clear owner handoff :thinking_face:
maria: say more. how is this different from our 72h followup?
jordan: 72h is fine for big incidents. micro-followup = same-day/lightweight for ops/owners: 1) confirm owner 2) set remediation ETA 3) flag blockers. keeps momentum without full retro
sam: i like that. would help with recurring patterns that never get traction
lee: question — who owns the micro-followup? IC or postmortem owner?
jordan: IC should kick it off in-thread before handoff. then postmortem owner (or squad lead) becomes owner for tracking. keeps IC rotation clean
maria: can we standardize timeline snippet? something we can paste into the thread and copy to the postmortem
praveen: +1. also need a tiny template for comms to stakeholders (one-liner + ETA)
inc-bot: Reminder: existing SLA - full postmortem draft due within 72 hours for Sev2+. Micro-followups recommended for all incidents.
jordan: draft template, pasteable:
```
MICRO-FOLLOWUP (quick)
- Owner: @owner
- Short goal: (what this remediation will fix)
- ETA: YYYY-MM-DD (or hh:mm UTC)
- Blockers: (permissions, infra, design)
- Next check-in: +48h
```
maria: perfect. add a line for "recurrence risk" so we can triage if this is a pattern
sam: propose we log micro-followups in the remediation board as a new card type "micro" so they don't get lost in backlog
lee: rotation note: IC should run micro-followup in the channel and @assign the owner before shift handoff. avoids dangling tasks when IC changes
praveen: ops question — do we want an automated reminder (inc-bot) at +48h if no update?
inc-bot: Actionable suggestion received. Recommend: inc-bot ping @owner at +48h if status is still "open". (ask eng-sre to opt-in)
jordan: ok next steps: 1) add micro template to incident KB (maria) 2) add an option in postmortem checklist (sam) 3) test inc-bot ping (praveen) 4) pilot with this week's oncall (lee)
maria: taking #1, will update KB by EOD tomorrow
sam: adding checklist item now, will post PR for review
praveen: I'll open an inc-bot task, ETA 3 days
lee: will run pilot on Wednesday IC shift and report back in this thread
jordan: awesome. small experiment, but should tighten followthrough and surface recurring patterns faster :rocket:
